questions.stem: A particle of mass 1.10 × 10^-26 kg moves at 2.00 × 10^3 m/s. What is its de Broglie wavelength?

options.misconception: Assumes a linear rather than inverse-square or exponential relation
Multiplies h by the momentum instead of dividing
Omits the velocity from the momentum

questions.hint: Divide Planck's constant by the particle's momentum m v.
